name: Tur Tyhyi
description: Tur Tyhyi is a writer, philosopher and field journalist working on autonomy, coordination and the structures beneath social systems. He spent two years documenting the full-scale war in Ukraine for French media, including AFP, from Bucha to the front line in Bakhmut and across the grey zone, where he ran his group's OPSEC. His work has focused on how people coordinate, adapt, trust and make decisions under pressure. He is the creator of Cypher Atlas, an interactive map of the crypto-anarchist and privacy ecosystem built entirely from public sources.
